core_obligations: Choose I^* K-injective representing M, J^* K-injective representing L, any K^* representing K; by the composition lemma there is a map of complexes Tot(SheafHom^*(J^*,I^*)  otimes  SheafHom^*(K^*,J^*)) -> SheafHom^*(K^*,I^*) (proof lines 10681-10688).

Choose a K-flat complex H^* with a quasi-isomorphism H^* -> SheafHom^*(K^*,J^*); the source of Tot(SheafHom^*(J^*,I^*)  otimes  H^*) represents R SheafHom(L,M)  otimes ^L R SheafHom(K,L) (proof lines 10689-10715).
Compose the two displayed arrows to get the desired functorial morphism; the proof that the construction is functorial is stated as omitted in the source (routine) (proof lines 10716-10720).
proof_roadmap: Build the composition map of complexes.
Insert a K-flat replacement for the derived tensor.
difficulty_reason: The proof picks K-injective representatives of M and L, uses the composition map of complexes from the composition lemma, inserts a K-flat replacement to represent the derived tensor, and composes; the functoriality verification is left to the reader in the source (routine bookkeeping).
